_note: GST rule pack (I5): when returns fall due and what the portal locks (GSTN advisories; CGST Rules 59, 61).

explain.en: A monthly GSTR-1 is due on the 11th of the next month.
explain.hi-Latn: Mahine wali GSTR-1 agle mahine ki 11 tarikh tak.

explain.en: A quarterly GSTR-1 under QRMP is due on the 13th of the month after the quarter; IFF for months 1 and 2 by the 13th of the next month.
explain.hi-Latn: QRMP mein quarter wali GSTR-1 quarter ke agle mahine ki 13 tak; IFF 13 tak.

explain.en: A quarterly GSTR-3B is due on the 22nd of the month after the quarter in Group I (Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Goa, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Daman and Diu, Dadra and Nagar Haveli, Puducherry, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep; Notification 76/2020) and the 24th elsewhere.
explain.hi-Latn: QRMP mein GSTR-3B quarter ke agle mahine ki 22 (dakshin-paschim States) ya 24 tak.

explain.en: From the July 2025 period the outward figures in GSTR-3B are filled from GSTR-1 and cannot be edited; corrections go through GSTR-1A before filing.
explain.hi-Latn: July 2025 se GSTR-3B ki bikri wali rakam GSTR-1 se aati hai, badli nahi ja sakti; sudhar GSTR-1A se.
